requests.submitted_prose: Kasliwal J. separately reasoned that the expired licence, fire-related vacating and absence of force or unlawful dispossession defeated Section 6 restoration in these circumstances. This is his opinion only, not the Bench's unified holding; the contrary opinion and referral remain unresolved in this document.

Ramaswamy J. separately relied on the concession, retained intention to possess and due-process protection of settled possession to uphold Section 6 restoration on his analysis. This is not a unified Bench merits decision or resolution of the regular lease/licence and title controversy.

policy: Submitted natural-language prose is displayed only as an unverified claim; the conditional conclusion is rendered from the reviewed rule and explicit binding.
interpretation: This display prevents status labels from endorsing arbitrary prose. It does not detect semantic errors in prose or approved translations.
